Location: Southampton
Description:

A Tug Master position is available for a permanent, time-for-time contract with a 1 week on / 1 week off rotation. The role requires a Master <500GT CoC or higher, valid ENG1 and STCW certificates, and experience in harbour or terminal towage with ASD and/or Voith propulsion. Candidates must possess strong leadership and communication skills, hold a UK driving licence, have the right to work in the UK, and reside within 30 minutes of Southampton port.
